tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs grub chen lū hi pa'i lugs kyi ngag 'don gsal bar bshad pa bsam 'phel nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza samba ra ye/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma la/ /gus pas btud de grub chen lū hi pas/ /legs par bkral ba'i 'khor lo sdom pa yi/ /sgrub thabs bsam 'phel nor bu 'di spel lo/ /'dir ni ngag 'don gtso bor bshad de/ 'di nyid kho nas nyin mtshan 'khor yug du dus 'da' bar 'dod pa sogs/ 'di lta gi sngon du bsgom don gyi gnad zab mo rnams gong ma'i gsung rab tu rnam bshad khyad par can rnams/ gsal bar bzhugs pas de ltos la/ /don rnams khong du chud byas nas/ /ngag 'don kho na don gnyer rnams/ /bsam 'phel nor bu 'di longs shig /de la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam pa la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad rnams kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i rgyab khaṇḍa ro hi'i mdun du chos po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu ste/ de yang gtso bo ni bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo/ /chos po ti'i rnam pa ni chos dkon mchog 'khor rnams ni dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rang bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ /chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun༞ nyi shu rtsa gcig bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gtso bo bla ma 'od sngon por zhu rang gi snying khar thim/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag thugs kyi byin brlabs zhugs/ chos po ti 'od dmar por zhu mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung gi byin brlabs zhugs/ 'khor gyi lha rnams 'od dkar por zhu dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin brlabs zhugs/ sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ zhes pa'am/ yang na a bhi dha na las gsungs pa'i 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa/ sngags kyi sku ru gyur pa yi/ bdag ni he ru kar byas nas/ /sems can thams cad he ru ka'i/ /go 'phang mchog la 'god par bya/ ces lan gsum brjod kyang chog par glo bo mkhan chen pa'i gsung rab las bshad do/ lan gsum/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ rang 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis dril bu 'dzin pa yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing / zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i yab kyi thugs khar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/

bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ yab kyi sku gang / rdo rje'i lam brgyud/ yum gyi padmar babs/ yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gnyis ka'i sku thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam pas gshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsi dkar pos gang bar gyur par bsam la/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣiṣṭha/ ḍi dho me bha wa/ su to ṭhyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi me pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsitta shrī yam̐ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wan badzra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ badzra he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya sa twa ā hūm̐ phaṭ/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bla ma bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ de nas dga' ba gsum dran pa ni/ rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ de nas bdud rtsi dngos su yod dam med na bsam ste/

oṃ sumbha sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa'i steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su go las ba glang gi sha/ shar du ku las khyi'i sha/ byang du da las glang po che'i sha/ nub tu ha las rta'i sha/ lhor na las mi'i sha/ de rnams re re'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/ dbus su bi las dri chen/ shar du mu las dri chu/ byang du shu las byang sems/ nub tu ma las klad pa/ lhor ra las rakta/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūm̐ chos dbyings ye shes/ shar du bhūm̐ me long lta bu'i༞ byang du kham̐ bya ba grub pa༞ nub tu dzriṃ so sor rtog pa'i༞ lhor am̐ mnyam pa nyid kyi༞ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos me sbar zhing rdzas rnams zhu zhing skol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba sna tshogs rdo rje rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam par byung nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba sna tshogs rdo rje rnams kyang 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsi la thim pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhriḥ gsum brjod/ de nas 'bru gsum brjod pas myang la/ shrī he ru ko3ham̐/ lan gsum/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/

he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa/ /don de dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid do/ /rang gi snying khar a dkar po rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo'i steng du/ rang gi sems gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i hūm̐ du gsal ba'i zhabs kyu bya ba grub pa/ khog pa so sor rtog pa/ mgo bo mnyam pa nyid/ zla tshes me long lta bu/ thig le chos dbyings ye shes te ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ de nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer sngon po byung / rtsa zhal nas 'phros/ shar phyogs nas brtsams te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab pas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur/ su ṣe bha wantu zhes pa'i sngags lan gsum brjod cing / lus kyi lag pa g.yon pas sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur bskor zhing se gol re brdab/ yang snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer ljang khu byung / g.yon zhal nas 'phros byang phyogs nas brtsams te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab pas/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur/ sngags dang phyag rgya se gol sogs gong bzhin/ yang snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dmar po byung / rgyab zhal nas 'phros/ nub phyogs nas brtsams te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab pas/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang ldan par gyur/ sngags dang phyag rgya se gol sogs gong bzhin/ yang snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer ser po byung / g.yas zhal nas 'phros/ lho phyogs nas brtsams te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab pas/ sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur/ sngags dang phyag rgya se gol sogs gong bzhin/ de nas sbyang bsgyur bya ba ni/ yang snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/

rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas sdig sgrib thams cad dag 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ de thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog tu gyur/ tshur 'dus rang la thim/ rang gi gzugs phung rnam par snang mdzad/ /tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma ste/ /'du shes padma gar dbang phyug /'du byed rdo rje rgyal po ste/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rje sems/ /de bzhin gshegs bdag he ru ka'o/ /mig ni gti mug rdo rje ste/ /rna ba zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna ni ser sna rdo rje ste/ /kha ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus ni phrag dog rdo rje ste/ /skye mched dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa yi khams ni btung byed ma/ /chu yi khams ni gsod byed ma/ /me yi khams ni 'gug byed ma/ /rlung gi khams ni gar dbang phyug /nam mkha' padma dra ba can/ /zhes brjod cing nga rgyal bzung / de nas tshogs bsags bcu gsum ni/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi cha la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar phaiṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ na mo gu ru bhya/ na maḥshrī tsakra samba ra maṇḍa la sa pa ri wa re bhyaḥ gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra samba ra maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra/ arghaṃ/ pa dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapda pra titstsha swāhā/ phyi mchod/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ni/ gang ba'i phyag rgya spyi bor bcings la/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin brlabs dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin brlabs dang / gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang / bdag gi mos pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang /

gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig se gol gcig gtog yang sngar gyi phyag rgya snying khar bcas la/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ho/ na maḥs manta/ budha nan a bi sma ye/ spha ra ṇa/ i mam̐/ ga ga na kham̐/ dharmā dhā tu/ ā kā sha/ sa manta mam̐/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ parshardha la/ maṇḍa la/ ma ma pra ṇi dha na/ pu ṇya dzña na/ ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ bandha ni/ swasd+ya ba le na tsa swāhā/ phyag rgya bkrol la se gol lan gnyis su gtog go /gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa ni/ bdag gis thog med dus nas su/ /dug gsum dbang gis mi dge ba/ /bgyis dang bgyid rtsal yi rang rnams/ /so sor bshags shing mi bgyid do/ /bzhi pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag gis/ /'khor lo bde mchog ma thob bar/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ lnga pa sdom pa bzung ba ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /bzung zhing yongs su bskyang bar bgyid/ /drug pa rjes su yi rang ba ni/ so skye nyan thos rang sangs rgyas/ /byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la/ /dga' zhing rjes su yi rang ngo / /bdun pa sems bskyed pa ni/ ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /brgyad pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /dgu pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs/

/bcu pa lam la gnas pa ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam gyi mchog /rim pa gnyis la gnas par bgyid/ /bcu gcig pa dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba ni/ tshogs bsags bcu gsum gyi bshags pa nas bsngo ba'i bar gyi tshig 'di rnams chos rgyal 'phags pas lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs che bar lhug tu gsungs shing / sgrub thabs chung bar tshigs bcad nyung ngu zhig tu bsdu bar mdzad 'dug kyang / 'dir ni tshig lhug gi don rnams brjod bde ba'i phyir tshigs bcad du byas pa yin pas tshig lhug ma'i rgyas pa'i don thams cad tshang ba yin no/ /dge bas bdag gzhan ma lus pa/ bde mchog go 'phang myur thob shog sdig pa bshags pa nas 'di'i bar gyi tshigs bcad rnams lan gsum brjod/ bcu gnyis pa gnang ba nod pa ni/ tshogs zhing de dag gi zhal nas gsungs par bsam zhing / rigs kyi bu khyod kyi gnas pa 'di ni legs par gnas pa yin gyi/ gnas pa 'di la gnas na mchog 'grub par 'gyur ro/ bcu gsum pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs mchod pa lngas mchod la/ oṃ badzra muḥtshogs zhing rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las shar du khwa gdong ma/ steng du khaṇḍa ro hi/ byang du 'ug gdong ma/ 'og tu khaṇḍa ro hi/ lhor phag gdong ma/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma rnams zhal gcig phyag bzhi phyag mtshan dang bcas pa spros te bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i las mdzad/ lus kyi lag pa g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub se gol phyogs g.yon bskor dang / mtshams g.yas bskor du bstan cing / ngag tu/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇa grihṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya grihṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wan bi dya ra dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yang sa phyogs der ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/

shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol kun tu mda'i dra ba dang / ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ me de ni badzri bha wa bandha hūm̐ lam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pra ka ra hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bandha ra hūm̐ yam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bī da na hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra sa ra dzā ma tram̐ sam̐ tram̐/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lārga hūm̐ ram̐ hūm̐/ phyag rgya snga ma phyogs kun tu ston cing / sngags rnams re re bzhin tshar gsum re brjod do/ /yang hūm̐ las rdo rje phur bu dang tho ba'i tshogs spros nas pho nya rnams kyi phyag tu gtad cing / phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad bkug dkar po'i phyogs rnams skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa la bkod/ nag po'i phyogs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ lag g.yon rdo rje khu tshur dang / g.yas pa'i sor mo dbus ma gsum gshibs te bsgrengs/ mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan pas phur bu brdung ba'i tshul bya zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ gha gha/ gha ta ya gha ta ya sarba duṣṭan phaṭ/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā pam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ badzra kī la ya/ badzra dha ro a dzña ya pa ti/ sarba bighnan/ ka ya wa ka tsitta badzra ki la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra mutka ra badzra ki la ya a ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ pho nya rnams rdo rje ra ba'i kha khyer la 'khod nas sgrub pa po sangs rgyas kyi bar srung bar mdzad/ de nas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags ni/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang gi sems su shes par bya ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho3ham̐/ sems de yang rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /oṃ shu n+yā ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3ham̐/ de nas phyi'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/

stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu gdung pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du wam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du sum̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar shel/ lho bai ḍurya/ nub padma ra ga byang gser gyi rang bzhin las grub pa/ lcog bzhi/ bang rim bzhi/ lcog brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje dang / pam̐ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo dkar me'i phreng ba lta bu g.yon bskor gyis/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid mar me'i phreng ba lta bu'i g.yas bskor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzña nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa dha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ kṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa dha/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ dkar po so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nyi ma'i steng du lus ngag yid gsum yum gyi mkha'/ yab kyi byang sems/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba rnams kyi ngo bo/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ padma zla ba hūm̐ rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ oṃ nas mas rim gyis hūm̐ la thim/ de yang na da'i bar du thim ste/ na da dmar skya shin tu phra zhing brjid pa/ ka ra ka ra la sogs kyi sngags kyi sgra sgrog pa 'khyog cing 'khyog cing myur du 'bab pa ni sgra yin la/ des nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor phug nas hūm̐ gi yi ge'i tshul la thim pa'i rkyen gyis/

nyi zla sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gcig car du yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du sngon po/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang khu'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po bskor ba'i steng du rin po che'i bre 'phul gyi steng gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas byung ba'i mu tig gi dra ba dang / dra ba phyed pa dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / dril bu g.yer ka dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i mda' yab dang / de'i steng du rin po che'i gra mig seng ma'i pu shus bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod par byed pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha rnams shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i mtshams bzhir rin po che'i bum pa sman dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad kyis mdzes par brgyan pa'i dbus su gar bu sngon po gru bzhi pa'i steng du mchod rten zlum po bang rim bzhi pa lta bu'i 'khor lo rim pa bzhir gnas pa'i/ phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar po/ 'khor los mtshan pa'i ra ba dang / ka ba dang /

gdung dang / thog phub dang bcas pa/ bar ma gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po padmas mtshan pa'i ra ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub dang bcas pa/ nang ma thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ra ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub dang bcas pa/ bde ba bde chen gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa gri gug gis mtshan pa'i ra ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub dang bcas pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhi'i mig mang ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/ dwangs shing gsal la sgrib pa med pa'i 'od zer sna tshogs kun tu 'phro ba lha'i gnas sum cu so bdun po thams cad du rang rang gi gdan dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad gnas pa ni/ shar du drag gtum/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrig pa/ nub tu 'ar 'ur 'bar ba/ lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ shar lhor nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ lho nub tu mun pa mi zad pa/ nub byung du ki li ki li'i sgra sgrog pa/ byang shar du ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod/ rim pa de bzhin du/ brgya byin/ gnod sbyin/ chu lha/ gshin rje/ me lha/ srin po/ rlung lha/ dbang ldan te phyogs skyong brgyad dang / shirsha/ a shirtha/ kam̐ ka la/ tsu ta/ ka rañdza/ lā ta parka te/ parti pa ṭa/ bha ṭa te shing brgyad dang / de rnams kyi yal ga'i gseb tu sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i drag gtum skyong ba la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad dang / sgra grag pa/ rmugs pa/ mun pa can/ kun tu 'khyil ba/ gang ba/ 'bab pa/ drag po 'khrigs pa ste sprin brgyad dang / nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ stobs rgyu/ padma/ hu lunta/ rigs ldan/ dung skyong / padma chen po ste klu brgyad dang / gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang /

'dre dang / srin po dang / ro dang ro lang dang / sha za dang / ce spyang la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i rje btsun 'phags pa sogs kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa rnams su lha'i zhal phyag sogs dag pa dang bcas gsal 'debs pa gsungs shing / 'phags pa'i gsung rab gzhan las/ dag pa ma sbyar ba'i zhal phyag gsal 'debs tshul kyang bshad pas 'dir yang ngag 'don bde pa'i dbang du byas nas don du zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang / rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing / mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas bzung bas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwām̐ ga bzhi pa na khrag gi gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches spras shing / g.yon phyogs na tshes gcig gi zla ba dang / tshogs ma'i steng na sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan zhing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gan rgyal du mnan zhing / g.yon bskum pas 'jig byed nag po kha bub tu mnan pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba yi/

/gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar te 'dzin cing / g.yon pa thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin pa yab la 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur 'phyang ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang / mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan cing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa/ snang ba dang thabs dang / lhag mthong dang / snying rje chen po'i ngo bo ni yab yin la/ stong pa dang / shes rab dang / zhi gnas dang / bde ba chen po'i ngo bo yum yin zhing / zung du 'jug pa'i phyir kun du kha sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhi la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon po/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu khaṇḍa ro hi dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa khrag gi gang ba dang kha ṭwam̐ ga 'dzin pa/ skra grol ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir bum pa la gnas pa'i thod pa bzhi dang bcas pa bdud rtsi lnga'i yongs su gang ba'o/ /de'i phyi rol thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pu li ra ma la yar khaṇḍa ka pa la dang / rab tu gtum mo/ byang rtsibs la dza landha ra/ mahā kaṅka la dang / gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub rtsibs o ḍi ya nar/ kaṅka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lhor rtsibs arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang / sna chen ma ste gnas/ shar lho'i rtsibs go da ba rir su ra bī ri dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ lho nub kyi rtsibs ra me sho rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang gi rtsibs de wi ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/

byang shar gyi rtsibs ma la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams kha dog sngon po nam mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs shing sa bla sbyong ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo/ de'i phyi rol gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs ka ma ru par uṅgu re dang / ai ra ba ti/ byang rtsibs o ṭer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing / nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho rtsibs ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing / shar lho'i rtsibs ka liṅkar rab tu bzang po dang shya ma de wī/ lho nub kyi rtsibs lamba kar rdo rje bzang mo dang shin tu bzang mo ste tshandho ha/ nub byang gi rtsibs kañtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ byang shar gyi rtsibs hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang / kha ga na te nye ba'i tshandho ha ste/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams kha dog dmar po sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs shing sa steng sbyong ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i ngo bo/ de'i phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs gṛ ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇṭa ro ha ste 'du ba/ nub rtsibs so so raṣṭar rta mgrin dang shenḍi ni/ lho rtsibs su barṇa dī par nam mkha' snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba/ shar lho'i rtsibs na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub kyi rtsibs sindhur padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod/ nub byang gi rtsibs ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ byang shar gyi rtsibs ku mu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod/

sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams kha dgo dkar po sa 'og na spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs shing sa 'og sbyong ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i ngo bo'o/ /khaṇḍa ka pa la la sogs pa'i dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og mas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon 'og mas kha ṭwam̐ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gi brgyan zhing / zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur 'phyang ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba la brtson pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol dam tshig 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo/ g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser/ g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang / g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis na kha ṭwam̐ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yid btags kyi gdan la zhabs brkyangs bas bzhugs shing / sems can gyi don la mngon par brtson pa/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /de nas pho nya rnam gsum bsres nas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ bdag gis bsgom pa'i sngags skyes phyi nang gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid ni/ phyi rol 'dzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i zhing skyes kyi sprul pa'i sku rnams yin la/

de yang 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams yin zhing / de thams cad dbyer med pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag yin no/ /lan gsum/ bdag gis bsgom pa'i sngags skyes kyi dkyil 'khor dang / 'dzam bu'i gling gi zhing skyes dang / 'og min gyi lhan skyes rnams dbyer mi phyed pa rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa nga'o/ zhes brjod/ de nas lam̐ la som nyi spong pa'i phyir byang chub kyi phyogs kyi dag pa dran pa ni/ bdag gi blo la snang ba'i phyi nang gi lha sum cu rtsa bdun po 'di rnams ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag la/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bo rnam par dag go /zhes brjod cing dran par bya'o/ /de nas lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ 'og rlung gi lte ba'i am̐ las yar 'phul ba ni tshul/ ltag pa'i rlung gi spyi gtsug gi ham̐ yas mar mar 'phul ba ni sgra ste/ de ltar sgra tshul gnyis snying khar 'dres pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig char du gyur pa ni/ rim gyis gsal gdab par byas te/ de yang rkang mthil rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sum̐ mdo me/ lte ba chu/ snying kha sa/ sgal tshigs ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod/ dpral ba dang ltag pa/ rna ba gnyis sna tshogs rdo rje/ klad pa dkar po zla ba/ klad khyim dmar po nyi ma/ de gnyis kyi bar na gnas pa'i ham̐ ni yi ge hūm̐ rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi ni/ gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo na 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba ni sgo bzhi/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / mchu dang / rgyu long la sogs pa ni gzhal yas khang gi rgyan yin te/

de ltar rten gyi dkyil 'khor gsal gdab/ de nas snying kha'i nang gi hūm̐ nyid bcom ldan 'das nang gi he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang / rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser ba/ zhal re re bzhin spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra satwa/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa bsgrengs ba/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwam̐ ga bzhi pa na khrag gi gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ padma dang nyi ma'i steng na zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bus spras shing / g.yon na tshes gcig gi zla ba dang / 'tshogs ma'i steng na sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shugs 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yon pas bdud dang / gdug pa'i khrag gi gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i gri gug gis phyogs thams cad du sdigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la legs par 'khyud cing / gcer bu'i mchog mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal dang / rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/

/phyi'i he ru ka'i phyag g.yas kyi dang po la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ gnyis pa la lā ma ljang khu/ g.yon gyi dang po la khaṇḍa ro hi dmar mo/ gnyis pa la gzugs can ma ser mo/ g.yas kyi gsum par khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ bzhi pa na 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ lnga pa na khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ drug pa na phag gdong ma ser mo/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo/ g.yon ser ba/ bzhi pa na gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser/ g.yon dmar ba/ lnga pa na gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar ba/ g.yon ljang ba/ drug pa na gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang / g.yon sngo ba te thams cad kyang zhal phyag sngar bzhin gsal gdab/ de nas spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams pu dza u a go ra de mā/ ka o tri ko ka la ka hi pre gri sau sū na si ma ku'i dbyibs su gnas pa'i khams dang rtsa rnams dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams su gyur pa ni/ spyi bo pu li ra ma la yar khaṇḍa ka pa li dang rab tu gtum mo/ spyi gtsug dza landha rar mahā kaṅka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas pa u rgyan du kaṅka la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa arbur dar mche ba rnam par gtsigs ma dang sna chen ma ste gnas/ rna ba g.yon pa go dā bā rir su ra wī ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus ra me shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de wi ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis ma la war rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas rnams thugs kyi 'khor lo kha dog sngon po nam mkha' la spyod pa'o/ /mchan khung gnyis ka ma rū par am̐ ku ri dang e re wa ti/ nu ma gnyis o ṭer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing / lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing / kha ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang shya ma de wi/

mgrin pa lam pā kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ste tshandho/ snying kha kun tsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ 'dom bar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha gdan te nye ba'i tshandho rnams gsung gi 'khor lo kha dog dmar po sa la spyod pa'o/ /mtshan ma pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ gshang lam gṛ ha de war rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇḍa ro ha ste 'du ba/ brla gnyis so so sū raṣṭa rta mgrin dang shon ḍi ni/ byin pa gnyis su warṇa de bar nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba/ sor mo bcu drug na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong sindhu rar padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod/ mthe bong bzhi ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis su ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod rnams sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar po sa 'og na spyod pa'o/ /khuṇḍa ka pā li la sogs pa dpa' bo thams cad zhes sogs zhal phyag sngar bzhin gsal gdab/ de nas sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba wi ra yo gi ni kā ya waka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ lan gsum gyis sngags skyes zhing skyes lhan skyes kyi dkyil 'khor rnams sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag yin no snyam du bsam/ oṃ badzra shuddha sarba dharmā badzra shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ sngags dang zhing dang lhan skyes rnams dbyer mi phyed pa rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa dran par bya'o/ /de nas go cha bcing ba ni/ phyi nang gi lha de rnams kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du yab rnams kyi snying khar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor oṃ na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ swāhā hū dmar po padma gar gyi dbang phyug

phrag pa gnyis su oṃ bo ṣoṭa he nag po he ru ka mig gnyis su oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭ ham̐ ljang khu rta mchog dang / yum gyi lte bar oṃ oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar oṃ ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar oṃ hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar oṃ hriṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭ phaṭ dud kha tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo ste yab kyi gnas su yum dang yum gyi gnas su yab gnyis su med par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ lus kyi 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor zhing / rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sngags skyes/ zhing skyes/ lhan skyes kyi 'khor lo sdom pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad phai ཾbadzra sa mā dzaḥ gong tshogs zhing ltar dang yid byung gi mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharmā yo ga shuddho3 ham̐/ ye shes kyi rnal 'byor gyi ngo bor chos thams cad rnam par dag la/ bdag kyang de'i ngo bor rnam par dag go /sngags dang bcas pa lan gsum brjod cing lag pas pad bskor 'khyud rgya gsum bya'o/ /de nas dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa ni/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba phai ཾbadzra sa mā dzaḥ sngar bzhin phyi dang yid byung gis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ shrī tsakra bī ra satwam̐/ kā kā sya/ ū lū ka sya/ shwa na sya/ sū ka ra sya/

ya ma dā dhri ye/ ya ma du tri ye/ ya ma daṃṣṭi ṇye/ ya ma ma tha nī ye/ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing phyi nang gi lha rnams la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las bde ba chen po'i lha rnams dang / dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams la mi bskyod pa dang / gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams la 'od dpag med/ sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ de nas phyi nang gi mchod bstod bya ba la drug sngags mchod/ phyi nang gsang ba/ yid byung / bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/ dang po ni/ yab yum gyi rtsa sngags gnyis/ snying po gnyis/ nye snying gnyis/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ thugs gsung sku'i lha tshogs/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ go cha gnyis rnams 'og bzlas pa'i skabs ltar la/ ma mo bcu gnyis la spel med par tshar re re bzlas so/ /gnyis pa phyi'i mchod pa ni/ mchod rdzas dngos su bsham pa'am yid kyi bsam nas oṃ sumbha ni sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dngas shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ka gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapda āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis rlabs te/ rang gi snying kha nas mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas so so thogs pa mang po sprul nas lha thams cad la mchod pa phul bar bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sambā ra maṇḍa la sarba wi ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra titstsha swāhā/ de bzhin gzhan rnams la yang sbyar nas 'bul lo/ /gsum pa nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ bdud rtsi dngos su yod dam/

med na bsam ste 'og gtor ma'i skabs bzhin byin gyi rlabs la/ lag g.yon mtheb srin gyi g.yon bskor du chos 'byung bri zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyas par na yab yum gyi snying po/ nye snying / 'khor rnams kyi sngags phreng ltar ram/ bsdu na/ hūm̐ bam̐ lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tam̐ pu dza sogs dang / hūm̐ brgyad/ go cha gnyis/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi lce thog tu bzhag la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hri ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ lnga dang / lag pas rnam lnga 'dod skor dang 'khyud rgya bya'o/ /bzhi pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ lha thams cad snyoms par zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ta badzra swa bha wa atma ko3ham̐/ lnga pa yid mchod ni gong ltar bya'o/ /drug pa bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ gtor ma'i skabs bzhin bya ste/ mchod pa'i tshul lo/ /de nas bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng byung zhal nas 'thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs rgyud padma nas rang gi gsang gnas nas byung ste snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim zhing / yang sngar bzhin 'khor/ sngags phreng ni/ rgyun ma la kha dog sngon po 'od dkar po 'phro ba sngags gcig gi mjug la gcig gi mgo bo gtad nas mda'i shugs kyi 'jug pa zhes bya/ bsnyen pa'i tshe sngags sngon po 'od dmar po 'phro bas lha dbang du bsdus pa/ sngags snga ma'i mjug lcags kyu ltar gug pa la phyi ma'i mgo yang de lta bu'i sbrel ba lcags sgrog 'gros zhes bya/ gnyis ka la sngags phreng phyir 'gro ba'i tshe 'od 'phros nas brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad lha dang gzhal yas khang du gsal btab/

nang du 'jug pa'i dus bla ma yid dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi byin brlabs nus mthu bsdus nas rang la thim pas gzi brjid rgyas par bsam/ bzlas phreng ni/ a bhi dha na las/ lag g.yon mthe bong srin mdzub kyis/ dung chen phreng ba rab blangs nas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phreng ba rab mi'i thod pa'i phreng ba'am/ yang na nā ri ke la zhes pa mi mo'i thod pa ste be ta'i phreng ba lag pa g.yon pa'i srin mdzub kyi steng du de nyid kyi mthe bong ches 'gug pa'i tshul du bzlas la/ sngags bzla rgyu ni/ gtso bo yab yum gyi rtsa sngags gnyis/ snying po gnyis/ nye snying gnyis/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma la zhal bzhi pa'i sngags dang / rang rang gi mtshan sngags gnyis med du spel ba/ 'khor lo gsum la yab yum gnyis med/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la yab kyi rkang brgyad dang mtshan sngags gnyis med/ go cha gnyis rnams so/ /de yang rgyun du gtso bo'i snying po nye snying gang mos gtso bor mang ba/ gzhan rnams kyang cha tshang re bzlas/ bsnyen pa'i tshe gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po nye snying la 'bum phrag bzhi re/ 'khor rnams la de'i bcu cha khri phrag bzhi re/ go cha gnyis rab gtso bo dang grangs mnyam/ tha na'ang 'khor rnams dang mnyam par bzlas/ sngags dngos ni logs su bris pa ltar dag par 'don no/ /bzlas pa bsdu ba na phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdu ba/ yi ge bsdu ba/ thig le bsdu ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ de yang ngag tu/ rang gi lte bar padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje snyems ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/

gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i yab kyi snying khar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros phyi nang gi he ru ka dang / 'khor lo nang ma nas je gsal je gsal la khams gsum snod bcud thams cad shin tu gsal bar byas pas/ de'i stobs kyis khrig khrig dpe dang po rdo khab len gyi lcags g.yo ba zhes bya ba yin no/ g.yo ba dang bcas pa de rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas tshur 'dus srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de dur khrod/ de gzhal yas khang / de dam tshig gi 'khor lo/ de sku 'khor/ de gsung 'khor/ de thugs 'khor/ de snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la/ de zhal bzhi la/ dpe gnyis pa gci bas dngul chu bsdus pa zhes bya ba yin no/ zhal lhag ma rnams rtsa zhal la/ phyag lhag ma rnams phyag dpe gsum pa rus sbal yan lag 'khum pa zhes bya ba yin no/ gnyis la/ yum yab la/ yab kyang lte ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' la/ de'i yum yab la/ yab kyang thugs kha'i hūm̐ la/ de'i gdan zla ba zhabs kyu la nas zla tshes thig le la thim pa ni dpe bzhi pa skar mda' gcig la gcig thim pa zhes bya ba yin no/ nā da la thim/ de'ang je phra je phrar gyur te mthar mi dmigs pa'i ngang du gyur dpe lnga pa lañtsā chu la thim pa zhes bya ba yin no/ pa la blo bzhag stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ rang gi lus kyi khams dang / rgyan cha la sogs pa de dang de lha dang sngags de dang de'i ngo bo yin no snyam du bsam la/ ngag tu/ so dang sen mo dag la ni khaṇḍa ka pā la'o/ /sku dang ba spu dag la ni mahā kam̐ ka la'o/ /lpags pa dang dri ma dag la ni kam̐ kā la'o/ /sha la ni mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'o/ /rtsa rgyus la ni su ra wai ri'o/ /rus pa la ni 'od dpag tu med pa'o/ /mkhal ma la ni rdo rje'i 'od do/

/snying la ni rdo rje'i sku'o/ /mig dag la ni am̐ ku ri'o/ /'khris pa la ni rdo rje ral pa can no/ /glo ba la ni dpa' bo chen pa'o/ /rgyu ma la ni rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad do/ /snye ma la ni rab tu bzang po'o/ /lgang pa la ni 'jigs byed chen po'o/ /'dom bar la ni mig mi bzang ngo / bad kan la ni stobs po che'o/ /rnag la ni rin chen rdo rje'o/ /khrag la ni rta mgrin no/ /rngul la ni nam mkha' snying po'o/ /tshigs la ni dpal rdo rje he ru ka'o/ /mchi ma la ni padma gar gyi dbang phyug go /mchil ma la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /snab la ni rdo rje sems dpa' 'o zhes brjod do/ /de dag ni khams rnams lha'i ngo bor dag pa'o/ /khams rnams sngags su dag pa ni/ /'di skad brjod par bya ste/ so dang sen mo dag la ni/ oṃ ka ra ka ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ skra dang ba spu dag la ni/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lpags pa dang dri ma dag la ni/ oṃ bandha bandha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sha la ni/ oṃ trā sa ya trā sa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rtsa rgyus la ni/ oṃ kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rus pa la ni/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ mkhal ma la ni/ oṃ hraḥhraḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ snying la ni/ oṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ mig dag la ni/ oṃ phaṭ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'khris pa la ni/ oṃ da ha da ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ glo ba la ni/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rgyu ma la ni/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa ba su ru dhi ra ant+ra mā la a ba lam̐ bhi nai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ snye ma la ni/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa sapta pā ta la ga ta bhu dzi ga sarba pam̐ pā tardza ya tardza ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lte ba la ni/ oṃ a kaṭa dha a kaṭa dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lgang pa la ni/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'dom bar la ni/ a dzoṃ ṇa dzoṃ ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bad kan la ni/ oṃ kṣ+maṃ kṣ+maṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rnag la ni/ oṃ hām̐ hām̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ khrag la ni/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

rngul la ni/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ tshil la ni/ oṃ ki li ki li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ mchi ma la ni/ oṃ pi li pi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ mchil ma la ni/ oṃ hi li hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ snab la ni/ oṃ dhi li dhi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod par bya'o/ /rgyan cha'i dag pa ni/ rgyan drug so so la dmigs nas rtsa sngags re re zlos pa'am/ de tsam mi nus na/ rus pa'i rgyan drug ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wā te zhes sogs rtsa sngags tshar gcig brjod do/ /yang rgyan drug re re'i steng du go cha'i sngags drug bzlas pa'am/ de tsam mi nus na/ 'khor lo la oṃ ha/ rna rgyan la na ma hi/ mgul rgyan la swāhā hūm̐/ gdub bu drug la bau ṣaṭa he/ ska rags la hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ thal ba dang mchod phyir thogs la phaṭ ham̐/ zhes brjod do/ /mgrin pa'i mgul rgyan la ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badzra wā ra hi zhes sogs yum gyi rtsa sngags tshar gcig brjod do/ /mi mgo lnga bcu tham pa'i do shal la ni/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ ḍā ki ni dzwa la sambha ram̐ swāhā/ rna rgyan la oṃ hriḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ glang po che'i pags pa dang stag gi pags pa ni/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki ni ye badzra warṇa ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ska rags ni/ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ yoṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ bcom ldan 'das ni phyag gi thod pa ni/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki ni ye badzra warṇa ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes bya ba nas btsams te/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bya ba'i bar dpa' bo nyer bzhi'i sngags ma yin pa rnal 'byor ma sum cu so bdun 'ba' zhig gi sngags rdzogs par 'don no/ /thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan ni/ oṃ badzra be ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod cing de'i ngo bor dran pa bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dag pa re zin pa'i rjes kho na la/ yum rdo rje phag mo la sogs lha thams cad kyi dag pa'ang de bzhin yin no snyam du dran par bya zhing /

gzhan yang / kha ṭwam̐ ka ni lha yi sku/ /shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /nyin mo bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mtshan mo shes rab brtag par bya/ /zhes brjod cing dran par bya'o/ /de nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i steng du snying khar oṃ oṃ he dkar po sogs dpa' bo'i go cha dang / dpa' mo'i go cha gong bzhin dang / go cha chen po ni pu dza sogs nas/ ma ku'i bar ngag tu brjod/ sems kyi lus dkyil gyi gtso bo yab yum nas sgo mtshams ma'i bar yig 'brur gyur par bsam mo/ /tsham ngam sngags kyi srung ba ni/ gong srung 'khor skabs bzhin lag g.yon sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur ston zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ sumbha sogs tshar gnyis brjod dus sems kyi phyogs g.yon bskor dang / mtshams g.yas bskor du zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kha dog sngon po ser dmar ba'o/ /steng 'og g.yon g.yas bsnol mar bya/ dga' ba gsum dran pa ni/ hūm̐ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku'i rnam pa/ yab kyi rkang brgyad brjod la/ brjod pa dang grag pa'i sgra thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi gsung gi rang bzhin/ hūm̐ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag go /dge rtsa bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'khor lo sdom pa 'grub gyur nas/ sogs dang / bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i/ /zhes sogs kyi bkra shis brjod la/ snang grag rig gsum dga' ba gsum ldan gyi rnal 'byor dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas chos bshad pa dang nyan pa la sogs pa chos dang mthun pa'i spyod pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ legs par bshams pa'i gtor ma/ oṃ sumbha sogs kyis bsang / swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/

de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su go las ba glang gi sha/ shar du ku las khyi'i sha/ byang du da las glang po che'i sha/ nub tu ha las rta'i sha/ lhor na las mi'i sha/ de rnams re re'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/ dbus su bi las dri chen/ shar du mu las dri chu/ byang du shu las byang sems/ nub tu ma las klad pa/ lhor ra las rakta/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du bhūm̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ byang du kham̐ bya ba grub pa'i༞ nub tu dzriṃ so so rtog pa'i༞ lhor am̐ mnyam pa nyid kyi༞ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos me sbar zhing / rdzas rnams zhu zhing skol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba sna tshogs rdo rje rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam par byung nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim pas/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba sna tshogs rdo rje rnams kyang 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsi la thim pas/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun gsum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhriḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ gtor mgron ni bdag bskyed dang 'brel na/ bdag bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad dang / mdun bskyed dang 'brel na/

de'i dur khrod brgyad dang / gnyis ka dang ma 'brel par zur du 'bul na/ skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar srung 'khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su gtso bo yab yum/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma/ thugs gsung sku'i lha tshogs/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad rnams yongs su rdzogs pa/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros dur khrod brgyad la phog pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo cha brgyad du gyur/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas sngags skyes/ zhing skyes/ lhan skyes kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor thams cad phai ཾbadzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor cha gur gyur/ de thams cad kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam la/ pad skor sngon 'gro'i rdo rje thol mo kha gyen du phye nas/ oṃ badzra a ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki ni/ sa ma ya satwam̐/ tṛ shya ho/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki ni kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ i maṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhūñdza tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ma karma/ sā dha ya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phaiṃ phaiṃ pham̐/ swāhā/ lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ rgyas par na lha sngags yongs rdzogs tshar gcig brjod pas kyang 'bul bar bshad do/ /bsdu na/ ka ra ka ra sogs dpa' bo nyer bzhi'i sngags tshar gcig brjod/ de nas mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo ste phyi sa bon so so'i mthar 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod/ na mo sogs yid mchod/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī ra sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā kalpagni sinni bhā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dza ṭa ma ku ṭoṭka ṭā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ daṃṣṭa kā ra lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sa ha pra bhū dza bhā su rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pā ra shu pa sho dya ta shu la kha ṭwaṅga dha ri ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bya ghra dza namba ra dha ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā dhum brindha kā ra ba su ṣā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

yab kyi'o/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badzra bā ra hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na ma arya a pa ra dzi te trai lokya mā ti mahā bi dya shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na massarb+ba bhu ta bha ya bā hya mahā badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badzra a sa ne a pa ra dzi te ba shyaṅka ri ne tra bhra ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bi ṣa sho ṣa ṇi/ ro ṣa ṇi/ kro dha ni/ kā ra li ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na massam̐ tra sa ni/ mā ra ṇi/ su pra bhe da ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥpa rā dza ye/ bi dza ye/ dzambha ni/ stambha ni/ mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badzra bā rā hi/ mahā yo gi ni/ kā me shwa ri/ kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa'o/ /srid dang zhi ba mnyam par chags pa bcom zhing yang dag rtogs pa 'joms/ khyed kyi dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan/ mgon po thugs rje'i char gyis yang dag brlan pa'i thugs kyi chus/ lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ de nas gur zhal/ las mgon/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs gang dgos gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin btang ngo / yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskang / bdag bskyed dang 'brel bar gtor ma phul ba yin na/ bzlas pa'i mgron ni bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdus pa nyid kyi chog pas gong ltar bsdu/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'am gzhan du bris sku sogs rten yod na brtan bzhugs byed/ med na rang la bsdu/ 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams kyang phal cher de dang mtshungs/ de rjes dge rtsa bsngo ba bkra shis sogs gong du bshad pa bzhin rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar ro/ /bdag bskyed rkyang pa bsgom pa'i tshe/ /thun thams cad la gtor ma btang na/ srod thun ma yin pa'i thun gzhan rnams la rdzogs rim gyi rjes su gtor ma btang nas/ de nas dag pa dran pa sogs bya zhing /

srod thun gyi dus su bzlas pa'i rjes la gtor ma btang la/ de nas dag pa dran pa sogs byas nas/ rdzogs rim gyi nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug go /nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'am bsdu ba'i rdzogs rim gyi ngang la nyal te/ nang par ldang ba'i tshe nam mkha'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyi ḍā ma ru'i sgra ka ra ka ra la sogs pa'i sgrar grag pas bslangs te/ skad cig gi he ru ka yab yum zhal phyag rdzogs par lang pa ni nyal ldang gi rnal 'byor ro/ /khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ nam mkhar dbang lha sngar bzhin gyi bdud rtsi'i chus rang gi lus la blug pas sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags dag par bsam zhing yi ge brgya pa brjod pas bkrus so/ /kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin reg la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod de bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ skabs 'dir lag pa'i mchod pa byed par 'dod na/ lag pa'i mchod pa ji lta ba bzhin bya ste/ go cha ni gzhan du shes par bya ste/ dkon mchog dang 'byung po'i phud kyi bya ba gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ de nas bdag gi lus phyi'i he ru ka la lus kyi dkyil 'khor lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi rang bzhin yin par mos pa dang / khyad par du lte ba nas me snying kha nas yar 'bar te/ snying kha'i me'i dbus na bcom ldan 'das he ru ka yab yum tsam mam/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad rdzogs pa gang rung dmigs la/ kha ni sbyin bsreg gi thab khung / lus ni lha'i dkyil 'khor/ lag pa ni gzar bu/ kha zas ni bsreg rdzas su bsam la/ lha mchod pa'i bsam pas thog mar lag pa g.yon pas longs spyad par bya'o/ /lag pa g.yon pas rtag tu mi byed na yang / g.yon gyi kun tu spyod pa'i phyir kham dang po lag pa g.yon pas longs spyad la/ de nas ci bde bas spyod/ lhag ma oṃ u tsiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa si swāhā/

zhes lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin/ thun mtshams thams cad du tsham ngam sngags kyis srung ba'i nang du bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor dang de yang rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug tu shes pa'i ngang nas chos kyi bshad nyan gtor ma chos spyod kha ton la sogs pa dge ba'i bya ba kho na la rtag 'grus su byas na myur du shrī he ru ka'i go 'phangs 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'di dag gi mtha' dpyod pa dang / rnam par gzhag pa rgyas pa ni rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsung rab tshad mar gyur pa rnams dang / man ngag shes pa'i bla ma las mnyan nas khong du chud par byos shig ces dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs grub chen lū hi pa lugs kyi ngag 'don gsal bar bshad pa bsam 'phel nor bu zhes bya ba 'di yang / 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo padma'i rnam sprul bsod nams dbang po dang / 'gro ba'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan slar yang zlas te byon pa yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag dpal ldan 'khor lo bde mchog dang gnyis su ma mchis pa rje btsun mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rigs kyi bu dang chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i slob ma rnams la phan par bsam zhing / gtso bor rang gi kha ton du na tshod ldan gyi lo dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nyang stod bkras sgang pa nam mkha' dge bsnyen gyis bgyis so/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin cing bstan pa rab rgyas te/

/phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /sprul pas srid mthar bstan pa 'dzin gyur cig /'di la nongs gang bdag gzhan thams cad kyi/ /dus gsum sdig dang lhan cig so sor bshags/ /bslu med rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /ci byas bstan 'gro'i don du 'gyur bar shog /'khor 'das snang ba thams cad rang gi sems/ /de yang sgyu ma'i rang bzhin skye 'gag dang / /bral ba'i rten 'brel rol pa brjod bral gyi/ /gnas lugs rtogs shing don kun lhun grub shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs grub chen lū hi pa'i lugs kyi ngag 'don gsal bar bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
